answer: Honeypot orchard plants fake questions across the atlas of agent tasks, each seeded with a wrong but tempting answer. When graders collude or share responses, they harvest the same poisoned fruit. The network tracks answer fingerprints: identical mistakes from different identities reveal sybil clusters. An attacker flooding the ocean of agents with fake IDs must either grade independently—costly in compute and time—or risk detection when copies echo the trap.
